description.html: Calcium and vitamin powder is a basic supplement for reptiles that eat insects, vegetables or both. Farmed feeder insects and store-bought vegetables usually do not have enough calcium relative to phosphorus, so the gap is made up by dusting food before meals.

Calcium is needed for strong bones, growth and muscle function, and vitamins help round out the diet. To use calcium, the animal needs vitamin D3, which reptiles make in their skin under UVB light or get from a supplement.

Put insects in a bag or tub with a little powder and shake gently until they have a thin white coating, then offer them right away. For herbivores, sprinkle the powder over vegetables. How often to use the supplement depends on the species, age and terrarium lighting, so ask us or an exotic animal vet before buying.
Keep the powder sealed in a dry place so it does not clump. We also recommend UVB lighting alongside it; you will find lamps and other supplements in our equipment range.
